about: okay-shop's assistant: the router lane's intents (okay-facts specs/design.md §17). Phrasings authored for the shop domain in pl, uk, ru, en; rules in okay-facts' portable dialect (\w Latin or Cyrillic letters). The probe is fitted on the examples (tools/fit.scala), the static table distilled over them (tools/table.scala).
